w1: Meet Open Planning Poker: free, open-source estimation for agile teams, with no sign-up. Here is everything it does, from sprint planning to the retro.
w2: Got a long backlog? Open the sorting board. Everyone drags tickets onto card columns in silence, and the tickets the team keeps moving are marked for a talk.
w3: After the reveal, the lowest and highest voters explain why in a short note, the room reacts, and everyone says how confident they are.
w4: When the whole team agrees, the room celebrates. Then share a read-only recap link with anyone.
w5: Keep every sprint in a team room: a velocity chart, the sprint history, and a sprint plan that scales the point budget to who is actually available.
w6: See how your sessions went, and build on your own data. Create an API token, read sessions and estimates, and get signed webhooks when a ticket is estimated.
w7: The public API is documented on the website, so you can build your own dashboards, bots and integrations, or just practise.
w8: Then run the retro in the same place. Write in silence, reveal, group similar cards, vote with dots, and agree on action items that come back next sprint.
w9: For bigger companies, organizations put several team rooms side by side, with each team's agreement and velocity, ready to download.
f2: Plus async voting, PDF and CSV export, dark mode, three languages, and an app you can install. GitHub, Linear and Azure DevOps are supported too.
